directory#user.meaning: The resource's declared kind on both captured samples. The current REST reference documents the live value as admin#directory#user instead.

examples.note: both captured samples; do not filter expecting admin#directory#user, the current reference's documented wire value

user_id.format: An opaque string, unique per account.
user_id.quote: A user id can be used as a user request URI's userKey.

examples.note: the vendor guide's own placeholder text, copied verbatim into both samples; not a realistic id shape, do not treat it as one

primary_email.quote: The primaryEmail must be unique and cannot be an alias of another user.

examples.note: primaryEmail; email and identity (both sourcetypes) and first (gws:users:identity) carry the same value on the dev index, they are convenience copies, not independent values

full_name.quote: The user's full name formed by concatenating the first and last name values.

phone_number.format: A phone number string, shape depends on the phones{}.type entry.

examples.note: the vendor guide's own placeholder text, copied verbatim into both samples; no real-shaped phone number has been observed for this pack

external_id_value.format: Free text; meaning set by the paired externalIds{}.type.

examples.note: type=custom, customType=office; the vendor guide's own placeholder text; read type and customType before trusting this column

account.meaning: The id identifies an account, not the person directly.

custom.meaning: A site-defined id kind; customType names it. Both captured samples use this value.

login_id.meaning: The id is a login identifier from another system.

network.meaning: The id identifies the user on a network.

organization.meaning: The id is issued by an organization.

hash_function.format: One fixed word naming the password hash format.

SHA-1.meaning: Password stored as a SHA-1 hash. The only value seen in the captured samples.

MD5.meaning: Password stored as an MD5 hash.

crypt.meaning: Password stored with crypt, supporting DES, MD5 ($1$ prefix), SHA-256 ($5$ prefix) or SHA-512 ($6$ prefix); a stated rounds prefix must be 10000 or fewer.

is_admin.quote: Indicates a user with super administrator privileges.

examples.note: both captured samples; only editable through the vendor's Make a user an administrator operation, not by writing this field directly
admin two; suspensionReason and suspensionTime are only present in the record when this is true

ADMIN.meaning: The account was suspended by an administrator. The only value seen in the captured samples; the vendor page names the field but does not publish a full code list.

examples.note: both captured samples; the account's own creation time, not when this record was captured

managed_by.format: Unconfirmed: present as a column on gws:users:identity's Splunk-side field list but empty on both sample events (dev Splunk query, 2026-09-19); no source path or meaning could be confirmed from the samples or the vendor's User resource reference, which does not name this field.

org_unit_path.quote: If the parent organization is the top-level, it is represented as a forward slash.

publish_time.format: Epoch seconds, may carry a fractional millisecond part.

examples.note: mechanically derived from data.creationTime for this sample per its own entry.json, not a captured real delivery time; treat as a stand-in, not an observed lag
